name: Venomancer: Venomizer and Master of Venoms modify the six Venoms
contract: #573 and #575: both passives are native spell modifiers, so no script is needed. Venomizer (680794) is a flat SPELLMOD_CHANCE_OF_SUCCESS (op 18) of +10 with class mask (0,0,0x10000000), which selects the six Venom activation auras (630868, 805731, 805775, 805776, 805777, 805778); their proc chance comes from Spell.dbc through spell_proc Chance 0 and Aura::CalcProcChance applies the modifier. Master of Venoms (504326) is a PCT SPELLMOD_DURATION (op 1) of +50% with class mask (0,0x8000,0) selecting the six payload auras. Each figure is asserted against the same run's unmodified value; the payload durations are the Spell.dbc durations (6000 and 8000 ms).
